name: Store acquisition metadata in a forensic image format
description: Records details such as case and examiner details, and the acquisition hash, within a forensic image container alongside the bitstream data or logical files.
details:
This is the counterpart of DFT-1193, which reads these same values back. 

Container formats such as EWF and AFF4 carry a case number, evidence number, examiner name, notes and description, together with the cryptographic hash computed during acquisition. 

DFT-1025 stores the bitstream itself, whereas this technique records the metadata that accompanies it. The hash written here is the value later verified against by DFT-1204. 

Metadata accompanying a raw image is held in a separate file rather than within a container, and is not covered by this technique.
